messages.author: 15a1174b6c9fb9a8
messages.subject: I am trying to change the title and labels of my legend(I'm a newbee)
parts:
How can i change the title name and labels in my legend?
Here is my code:

Obama <- ggplot(data=TS, aes(x=UNRATEchange,y=GDPC1annual ))+
geom_point(shape=16, aes(color=factor(Obama)))+
theme(legend.key.height = unit(0.3, "in"), legend.key.size = unit(0.5, "in"))+
  
ggtitle("Okun's Law Relating GDP Growth to the Change in Unemployment") + 
  ylab("Quarterly growth rate of Real GDP (% annualized)") +
  xlab("Quarterly Change in the Unemployment Rate")+
  # Add linear regression line 
  #  (by default includes 95% confidence region)
  geom_smooth(method=lm, se=FALSE)

Thank you

messages.author: bfc2eb6b71169017
messages.subject: Re: I am trying to change the title and labels of my legend(I'm a newbee)
parts:
To change labels, change factor levels, e.g. To modify the title, use appropriate scale. In this case, it's `scale_color_discrete`.

library(ggplot2)

levels(iris$Species) <- c("I. setosa", "I. versicolor", "I. virginica")

ggplot(iris, aes(x = Sepal.Width, y = Sepal.Length, color = Species)) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_discrete(name = "Species of Iris") +
  geom_point()

Cheers,
Roman
